important_factors: Buyer confirmed the unconfirmed 500-unit corporate bulk order should not be purchased for, and only normal forecast demand should be covered.
Current usable inventory is 600 units with 0 open orders against 1680 units of forecast demand over the 28-day planning horizon.
1280 units are needed to meet baseline demand and maintain 200 units safety stock; rounding up to SUP-A's 100-unit pack size yields 1300 units.
Creating PO for 1300 units from SUP-A at $9.00/unit ($11,700.00 total) arriving 2026-09-22 completely avoids projected stockouts starting 2026-09-27.
args.rationale: Following explicit buyer instruction, we exclude the unconfirmed corporate bulk order of 500 units and procure only for normal forecast demand. Over the 28-day horizon, daily demand of 60 units requires 1680 units total. With 600 units of usable inventory on hand and 0 open orders, net baseline demand is 1080 units. Adding the 200-unit safety stock requirement brings total needed stock to 1280 units, which rounds up to 1300 units based on supplier SUP-A's pack size of 100 units. Ordering 1300 units for arrival on 2026-09-22 completely resolves the projected baseline shortage of 1080 units starting 2026-09-27 and leaves a closing inventory of 220 units (3.7 days of cover, within the 12-day policy limit). The total cost of $11,700.00 is feasible under the $30,000.00 budget and storage limits, though it exceeds the $2,000.00 autonomy spend limit and requires buyer approval.
